# Screen catalog

Every screen of the dashboard, as it looks in a desktop browser and on a phone. Click a picture for the full size.

The pictures come from the simulator that ships with the project, which serves the same dashboard as the firmware, with sample data. Pages of devices you did not add to your sketch (the map, the LCD, the files) appear only when their module is in the firmware.
